description: Server entry point for a Remix-based web application, handling HTTP requests, determining if the request is from a bot or browser, and streaming server-side rendered React components.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, manages OPTIONS requests, and delegates to bot or browser specific request handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests identified as from bots, streams server-side rendered output for bots.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from browsers, streams server-side rendered output for browsers.
